_comment: Ratchet baselines for checks/run.js. Baselines only move toward the target, with the reason recorded in the PR that moves them. allowedExternalPrefixes is EMPTY and stays empty: since S5 the game embeds its own fonts and references nothing off-origin (invariant 4).
_mathRandomComment: S3 routed all 93 call sites through the seeded engine. The one that remains is rand()'s own pre-game fallback, for the window before S exists where there is nothing to be reproducible about. The sandbox's Math.random swap is an assignment, not a call, so it does not count here — it stays as isolation for any stray call this file grows later. A rise means a new unseeded source of randomness: route it through rand() instead.
_sizeComment: S9g moved this 1,600,000 -> 1,750,000, S9h -> 1,900,000, S10a -> 2,100,000. The binding invariant is self-containment, not bytes: one file, no build step, no external reference, opens from file://. The ratchet exists to catch growth nobody decided on, and every move here was decided on. S9g: twenty-four statutes in each of the twenty core categories (131 new, 95 KB). S9h: four authored rungs on the 451 statutes that were already here (167 KB). S10a: raised BEFORE the work that needs it rather than after, because the owner's fifth order includes a book of at least 36 executive orders, roughly 32 new grand works, and expanded material for Question Time and the political papers — an estimated 135-150 KB — and discovering the ceiling midway through that would mean content authored and unable to land. Headroom stays deliberately finite so the ratchet still bites on anything unplanned. S10g: -> 2,200,000. The tail of the S10f authoring run rewrote eighteen shards AFTER the first seventy questions had been merged and shipped, leaving forty-five more on disk that no build had seen; levelling the five subjects that had been left shallow adds twenty-five more. Ninety-two KB of authored question, taking Question Time from five sentences in an if/else chain to a hundred and sixty-four questions, twelve on every one of its fourteen subjects. The owner's ninth item was 'expand or remove'; this is the expansion, and it is the last of it. Headroom stays deliberately finite so the ratchet still bites on anything unplanned.
_tiersComment: S6a collapsed 13 accreted width thresholds to these five, one per tier edge plus the small-phone refinement the user sanctioned. Six chunks each picking its own 'narrow' number is how the tablet band ended up half-dressed, so a new threshold fails this check. Adding one is a design decision: make the case in the PR, then add the number here.
_heightComment: The one height threshold in the file: the landscape/short-window turn bar. It was governed by nothing until the breakpoint check learned about the height axis.
_tenthComment: S9d added the v10 Descent chunk (7->8): the engine that makes the descent roads real. The case is in PR #19; the chunk defines no ensure function and never wraps enrichState, so the S3 dice guard stays outermost.
